metadata.title: CONSIDÉRATIONS GÉNÉRALES SUR L'ANALYSE ORGANIQUE ET SUR SES APPLICATIONS

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (popularized by Didot and Bodoni) common in early 19th-century French printing.
